text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Passing near the dance studio—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Phew..., phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *pant*..., *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Slam!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! Neither of you can give up!
Just a little bit more!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, I'm so, so sorry...!
Even though you've taught me dozens of times...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, Taiki-san has been teaching me,
but I just can't seem to get the rhythm down at all...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I had memorized the choreography properly,
but when it comes to actually doing it... ugh."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, maybe I'm the one
holding you back...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Throw away the negative thoughts!
Both of your souls came through loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Next is hot!!
More hotter, please!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hot!? Wh-What on earth should I do about that...!?
choice_data_list: Why don't we make the music a little hotter?
How about we have some hot tea?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a volume boost, yes?!
Leave it to meee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
as Taiki Shuttle turned up the volume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Boom-ba-doom, boom-ba-doom, boom-ba-doom!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even louder than before,
the deep bass of the drums resonated—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yahoooo!! Boom-ba-doom-ba-dooom, yeees!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! This is almost like...
war drums rousing a hero...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Dondoko, dondoko, dondokodokodoko!!
Dondoko, dondoko, dondokodokodoko!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—It's just like the racing heart
of that manga heroine...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: This is true courage...! This is true grit...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: This is――――SO HOT!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heated up, their bodies begin moving on their own. Keeping the rhythm is great and all, but—!
choice_data_list: (Isn't that sound a bit too loud...!!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I was about to warn them,
the dance instructor scolded the three of them
to keep the volume down."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! A samurai always picks his teeth with delicious toothpicks,
as they say!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Very nice idea!
Let us go have a hot tea time, YES~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does this mean you
"can't fight on an empty stomach"~...!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: How is it? Does your heart feel nice, warm, and toasty?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that really touched my heart...!
I feel like I've been able to relax a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, me too. That was a nice change of pace."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Very good!! Now, keeping this momentum going,
let us get our bodies nice and hot, YES~~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! Taiki-san, Dober-san, I look forward to continuing to work with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying some warm tea,
the three of them resumed their dance lesson
in a relaxed mood.
